offerings.name: Reader for web search and SERP
offerings.pricing: Token-based: Prototype Development—1 Billion tokens for $50 ($0.050 / 1M tokens); Production Deployment—11 Billion tokens for $500 ($0.045 / 1M tokens).

offerings.output_type: Top five web results with their URLs and contents, each in clean, LLM-friendly text; JSON mode returns five structured entries.
